instrumentation_notes.coverage: WIRED but NOT GATED. .github/workflows/windows-validation.yml:346 ('Code coverage (OpenCppCoverage -> Cobertura) - best-effort', Register M-e) already runs OpenCppCoverage.exe against build/vs2022/bin/Debug/pdfe_tests.exe and uploads Cobertura XML, but continue-on-error:true, skips if the tool is absent, and enforces NO coverage floor. Gap = add a coverage-floor/kill-rate gate on top of the existing step (small Phase-1/4 task), NOT stand up new tooling. Cross-platform alt if needed: clang-cl + source-based llvm-cov (windows-fuzz lane already uses clang-cl).
instrumentation_notes.junit_xml_gap_a15: tools/gate/check_junit_xml.py already implements the GAP-A15-safe parse: pdfe_tests.exe can exit 0 while the XML records failures, so trust the XML not the exit code. It asserts sum(failures)==0 across <testsuite>, tests>0 (empty run != pass), and optional --min-tests N to guard silent suite shrinkage. Tell-tale of masked failure: tests != passed+skipped. CI must run tests with --gtest_output=xml and pipe through this parser.
instrumentation_notes.mutation_testing: No off-the-shelf C++ mutation harness. Home-grown: tools/gate/mutation_kill.py + tools/gate/mutants.json — each mutant is a single exact-unique source substring edit (find/replace) validated by --dry-run, then apply->rebuild(debug-vs2022)->run killing_test->expect the named test to fail (killed). CURRENTLY ONLY 3 SEED MUTANTS (coord-mapper origin sign, rot90 axis, +1). Phase-4 must grow this set per-subsystem (flip conditionals, drop emitted operators e.g. op_Tz(100), perturb signs/matrix terms) and wire mutation-kill.yml as a kill-rate floor gate. Build cmd/preset live in mutants.json.build.

assertion_count_note: Three independent regex recounts of EXPECT_*/ASSERT_* over tests/test_*.cpp agree to within ~0.3%: initial quick-grep ~13975, census section-5 aggregate 13942, authoritative per-file recount 13937. The spread (max 38 of 13937 = 0.27%) is pure regex-method variance: whether the macro-tail char class is [A-Z_] vs [A-Za-z] (the latter silently drops multi-underscore macros such as ASSERT_NO_THROW / EXPECT_NO_FATAL_FAILURE), line-based vs match-based counting, and multi-line/commented macro handling. None is material. AUTHORITATIVE GROUND TRUTH = the per_file[] sum below = 13937 assertions (regex \b(EXPECT|ASSERT)_[A-Z_]+\( , match-based, over 402 files). The section-5 per-subsystem 'assertions' columns are left at their original 13942-method values (delta 5, 0.036%) and are NOT authoritative for exact totals; per_file[] is.
